note: One definition of 'how many lines did this edit change'. The server counts an edit call's lines from the transcript's toolUseResult (server/src/logs/tool-stats.ts -> countPatchLines, the source of truth); the hook counts the same thing from the CLI's tool_response (hook/.claude/telemetry_tool/edit-result-counts.js -> countPatchLines, a verbatim port), because a workflow-agent transcript never carries a usable toolUseResult. Two implementations that disagreed would make a session's numbers depend on which side happened to cover the call. These cases run through BOTH implementations: server/src/logs/tool-stats.spec.ts and hook/.claude/telemetry_tool/__tests__/edit-result-counts.test.js. Update the fixture together with whichever side actually changed; a mismatch means one of them drifted.
